interpretation.supported: A strict answer-span gate can eliminate the lexical gate's observed wrong-trace and target-removal selections on this consumed slice while retaining fully grounded, parseable evidence.
interpretation.rejected: qwen3.5:4b with this contract is not usable as the recall authorization gate because it preserves only one of eight answer-bearing targets in each positive intervention condition.

root_cause: The carrier and source grounding are reliable, but the selected local 4B model is over-conservative on long multilingual memory records. Its zero wrong selections are achieved by rejecting most true answer-bearing records.
next_falsifiable_hypothesis: With the exact prompt, native tool carrier, grounding validator, interventions, and gates fixed, a local model capacity screen can determine whether the false-negative problem is model capacity rather than the answer-span contract itself.
next_experiment_constraints: Do not alter the semantic prompt or verdict schema.
Do not tune on case-specific words, official answers, or expected trace IDs.
Keep the same exposed cases development-only.
Compare locally installed models under the same generation and selection controls.
Do not build a fresh holdout unless one model passes every frozen development gate.
Do not integrate runtime until a later disjoint holdout passes.
